target.purpose: Make automated traffic authority explicit, replay-resistant, hierarchically budgeted, and attenuating across delegated edge actors.
target.central_bottleneck: A flat self-declared RPS ceiling cannot prevent intent-ID rebinding, aggregate delegated budget expansion, request replay, or child authority that exceeds its parent.

invariants: strict intent identity is immutable once registered
delegated purpose cannot expand beyond parent purpose
delegated RPS cannot exceed parent RPS
delegated validity cannot begin earlier or end later than parent validity
aggregate delegated request allocation plus parent consumption cannot exceed parent total budget
successful request IDs cannot consume budget twice
child receipts bind the exact parent fingerprint and delegation depth
legacy flat gate remains distinct from the stronger strict ledger path
nonclaims: reference traffic-authority ledger, not production Cloudflare enforcement
intent issuer authenticity is not cryptographically verified
nonce and budget state are in-memory rather than durable distributed state
